change3: - Changed: The 'IA' Diagram view button has been removed since it is no longer needed.
change4: - Changed: The progress bar in the Map and Diagram views has been removed temporarily due to a bug in some core python code.
change5: - Changed: Python installations that use 'pyenv' version manaageement, take note: tcl-tk has been upgraded to version 9 (brew install tcl-tk), which may cause an error when importing tkinter.  If this error occurs:
change6: - if running python 3.11.10 or lower, then the new tcl-tk is not recognized and you will get an import error for 'tkinter'.  Issue the commands (in the order specified):
change11: - if running python 3.12.4, upgrade to 3.12.7 (the latest): 'pyenv install 3.12:latest'
change12: - Python version 3.13.0 works fine with the new tcl-tk.

change16: - Fixed: Optimize the connector alignment in the Diagram view (performance enhancement).

change18: - Fixed: Diagram buttons dissapear if the right side of window is shifted/resized to the left.
